definitions.gloss: running about in confusion, being in a panic, going back and forth in disorder
definitions.explanation: To rush around aimlessly in a state of confusion or panic, unable to decide what to do. Literally means going right and going left — i.e., running in every direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{右往左往|うおうさおう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: People ran about in confusion because of the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{右往左往|うおうさおう}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The employees were running around in confusion due to the sudden power outage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧{右往左往|うおうさおう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いて→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Instead of panicking when plans suddenly change, let's respond calmly.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右往左往|うおうさおう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (run about in confusion)
- {右往左往|うおうさおう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (be in a panic)

USAGE:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) composed of {右|う} (right) + {往|おう} (go) + {左|さ} (left) + {往|おう} (go). Vividly describes the chaotic scene of people going right and left without direction. Always implies a lack of composure or clear thinking, often triggered by an unexpected event. Similar in meaning to ⟦うろうろ→うろうろ：05168_urouro⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ and ⟦おろおろ→おろおろ：05369_orooro⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, but {右往左往|うおうさおう} is more literary and emphasizes the collective confusion of a group.
